name: zclass_cls_di_build_pick_candidates_for_point_batch
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForPointBatch clamps multi-point probe samples to the world grid, dispatches eligible nodes through the point-picking walker, restores shifted query coordinates, and fills per-sample candidate buckets.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass display-instance picking/source-cluster pass.
